Did our prophet SAW never used his left hand while counting tasbeeh? Question: Assalam o alekum Is it forbidden to count tasbeeh using left hand? Did our prophet SAW never used his left hand while counting tasbeeh? Answer ID: 19392 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 190/190/M=1431) (1) No, it is not forbidden. (2) There is no such explanation narrated in Hadith. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
